The suit chooser’s picked suit

First the suit chooser as it ships. Then the picked suit as a dialog’s white card, with the card’s white, the line round it and its soft lift, as the Settings dialog draws its white cards. Versions 2 and 3 add your two notes of 1 Oct. Version 2 has no lines between the suits. Version 3 also puts the frontpage’s darker paper under them. Tap a suit to move the pick. Every piece is drawn by the site’s own stylesheet.

What to look for

Today the picked suit sits on the empty rating star, a darker warm grey with a dark edge. A white card on the chooser’s paper is much quieter, since the paper is almost white. Its edge, the dialog line, carries most of the mark. On the darker band paper the white card stands out more. It stands out more still with no lines between the suits.

A suit you cannot pick is drawn in the line in every version, as today.

How it would be built

Version 1 changes the three colours of the mark in pieces.scss (--trump-pill-thumb, its ring and its lift) and nothing else. The lift is written out, since the card’s own --lift-card token is declared for dialogs only. Version 2 also drops the line between the suits. Version 3 also turns the chooser’s paper to the band paper, with the soft line as the hover. The rules are at the bottom of chooser-lab-parts/lab.css.

Round 8 of the second bug hunt asked the same question on 1 Oct (its lab’s page R8-SUIT-BAND, still unanswered), with pictures from the dev site. Its V1 is version 3 here with today’s smaller lift.
